title: Light and colour for the Green Campus console
question: The client found the pages too monochrome and asked for light mode. Pick the look for the app. Every option adds a blue action colour, one colour per load type and room-type tints; the single-line diagram, amber-for-waste and the red/green panel lamps stay. Use the steer box to pair a light and a dark option (e.g. 'Drawing Sheet for light, Dusk for dark').

options.label: Drawing Sheet
options.lineage: issued electrical drawings: white sheet, blue-black ink, drafting blue
options.thesis: Clean white working surface; colour carried by load types, room tints and a blue action colour.
options.viewport: Light rail and top bar, blue primary button, rooms tinted by type, device rows with coloured load-type chips.
options.risk: Calmest of the four; the colour is present but restrained, so it may still read as 'business' rather than lively.

options.label: Daylight
options.lineage: same sheet, with a navy control strip like a panel's nameplate
options.thesis: Light pages framed by a navy rail and top bar; stronger room tints so the floor plan reads at a glance.
options.viewport: Navy rail and top bar with white text, light content area, plan tiles clearly tinted by room type.
options.risk: Most colourful; the navy frame is a strong brand moment that must stay consistent on every page.

options.label: Dusk
options.lineage: the night panel with the lights half on: slate instead of black
options.thesis: A softer slate-blue dark that is easier on non-technical eyes, with brighter load and room colours.
options.viewport: Slate rail and top bar, blue primary button, rooms tinted by type, coloured load chips on slate.
options.risk: Still a dark theme; pair it with a light option for the client's light mode.

options.label: Night + colour
options.lineage: today's night panel with the new colour roles added
options.thesis: Keeps the current near-black panel but adds the blue action colour, load-type colours and room tints.
options.viewport: The current dark console, now with a blue primary button, tinted rooms and coloured load chips.
options.risk: Least change from today; the client found the current dark heavy, so best only as the dark option.
